content.title: 3 biggest consumer trends from holiday shoppers this year
content.description:
Marketing automation platform Klaviyo (KVYO) works with over 186,000 brands, including Mattel, Unilever, Liquid Death, and many more. As the holiday shopping season kicks into high gear this week ahead of Black Friday, what are these top brands seeing from consumers and how they engage with their products?

Klaviyo CEO Andrew Bialecki sits down with Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman to talk about how his company connects consumers with brands and three of the biggest themes or trends he is observing about consumer spending.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
